name: sendinblue
label: Brevo
description: Email, SMS and contact marketing platform, formerly Sendinblue.

apiKey.label: API Key
apiKey.description:
To get your API key:
1. Log in to Brevo.
2. Open the account menu, go to **SMTP & API** and open the **API Keys** tab.
3. Click **Generate a new API key**, name it and copy the key.

find_contact.label: Find Contact
find_contact.description: Check whether a contact exists in Brevo and fetch its details.

identifier_type.label: Look Up By
identifier_type.description: What kind of value you are searching with.

identifier.label: Value
identifier.description: The email, number or ID to search for.

unsubscribe_contact.label: Unsubscribe Contact
unsubscribe_contact.description: Blacklist a contact so it stops receiving email or SMS.

email.label: Email
email.description: The contact is matched by this address.

unlink_list_ids.label: Remove From Lists
unlink_list_ids.description: Lists to take the contact off.

send_transactional_email.label: Send Transactional Email
send_transactional_email.description: Send one email, written here or from a saved Brevo template.

reply_to_email.label: Reply To
reply_to_email.description: Where replies go. Empty: back to the sender.

sender_email.label: Sender
sender_email.description: The verified sender the email is sent from.

sender_name.label: Sender Name
sender_name.description: Replaces the display name of the selected sender.

template_id.label: Template
template_id.description: Send a saved Brevo template instead of supplying subject and content.

params.label: Template Parameters
params.description: Values for the template placeholders, by name.

subject.label: Subject
subject.description: Required when no template is picked.

html_content.label: HTML Content
html_content.description: Required when no template is picked.

text_content.label: Text Content
text_content.description: Plain text version for inboxes that cannot show HTML.

attachments.label: Attachments
attachments.description: Files by public URL that Brevo downloads when sending.

tags.label: Tags
tags.description: Labels used to filter this message in Brevo reporting.

scheduled_at.label: Send At
scheduled_at.description: Leave empty to send right away.

sandbox.label: Sandbox Mode
sandbox.description: Brevo checks the request but delivers nothing.

send_transactional_sms.label: Send Transactional SMS
send_transactional_sms.description: Send a transactional SMS from your Brevo account.

sender.label: Sender
sender.description: Up to 11 letters and digits, or 15 digits only.

recipient.label: Recipient
recipient.description: Country code first, no + or leading zeros.

content.label: Content
content.description: Over 160 characters is sent as several messages.

type.label: Message Type
type.description: Transactional for order and account notices, Marketing for promotions.

tag.label: Tag
tag.description: Label used to filter this message in Brevo reporting.

web_url.label: Webhook URL
web_url.description: Brevo posts delivery reports for this message here.

unicode_enabled.label: Send as Unicode
unicode_enabled.description: Needed for emoji and non-Latin text; 70 characters per part.

organisation_prefix.label: Brand Name
organisation_prefix.description: Shown before the message so people know who sent it.

create_event.label: Create Event
create_event.description: Track a custom event for a contact.

event_name.label: Name
event_name.description: How the event is named in Brevo.

event_date.label: Date
event_date.description: Leave empty to use the current time.

event_properties.label: Details
event_properties.description: Event data, such as an order ID and total.

email.label: Email
email.description: The contact the event belongs to.

contact_properties.label: Attributes
contact_properties.description: Contact attributes to update, such as FIRSTNAME.

create_event.beforeRequest:
['event_properties', 'contact_properties'].forEach(function (key) { var v = request.body[key]; if (v && typeof v === 'object' && Object.keys(v).length === 0) delete request.body[key]; });
return request;

list_contacts.label: List Contacts
list_contacts.description: List contacts in a Brevo account, optionally filtered by list, segment, or modification date.

list_ids.label: List IDs
list_ids.description: Only return contacts belonging to these list IDs. Mutually exclusive with Segment ID.

segment_id.label: Segment ID
segment_id.description: Only return contacts belonging to this segment. Mutually exclusive with List IDs.

created_since.label: Created Since
created_since.description: Only return contacts created on or after this date.

modified_since.label: Modified Since
modified_since.description: Only return contacts modified on or after this date.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Number of contacts to return. Maximum 1000.

offset.label: Offset
offset.description: Number of contacts to skip, for pagination.

sort.label: Sort
sort.description: Sort contacts on their creation date.

update_contact.label: Update Contact
update_contact.description: Update an existing Brevo contact by email, phone, contact id, external id, WhatsApp id, or landline number.

identifier.label: Identifier
identifier.description: The value to look the contact up by, for example an email address.

identifier_type.label: Identifier Type
identifier_type.description: How the identifier above should be interpreted.

attributes.label: Attributes
attributes.description: Pass the set of attributes and their values. Attribute names must already exist in your Brevo account and be passed in capital letters, for eg: {"FNAME":"Elly", "LNAME":"Roger"}. Only the attributes you list are changed; the rest are left as they are.

ext_id.label: External ID
ext_id.description: Sets a new external id for the contact.

email_blacklisted.label: Email Blacklisted?
email_blacklisted.description: Whether the contact is blacklisted for emails. Leave empty or pick Leave unchanged to keep the contact's current setting.

sms_blacklisted.label: SMS Blacklisted?
sms_blacklisted.description: Whether the contact is blacklisted for SMS. Leave empty or pick Leave unchanged to keep the contact's current setting.

list_ids.label: Add to Lists
list_ids.description: Lists to add the contact to.

unlink_list_ids.label: Remove from Lists
unlink_list_ids.description: Lists to remove the contact from.

blocked_sender_addresses.label: Blocked Sender Addresses
blocked_sender_addresses.description: Sender email addresses this contact must not receive transactional email from. Leave empty to change nothing.

delete_contact.label: Delete Contact
delete_contact.description: Permanently delete a contact from Brevo.

identifier.label: Identifier
identifier.description: The value to look the contact up by, for example an email address.

identifier_type.label: Identifier Type
identifier_type.description: How the identifier above should be interpreted.

import_contacts.label: Import Contacts
import_contacts.description: Bulk import contacts into Brevo from a file URL or an inline list of rows.

file_url.label: File URL
file_url.description: Public URL of a .txt, .csv, or .json file containing the contacts to import. Mutually exclusive with Inline Contacts.

json_body.label: Inline Contacts
json_body.description: Contact rows to import directly, without a file. Mutually exclusive with File URL.

new_list_name.label: New List Name
new_list_name.description: Creates a new list with this name and imports into it. Requires New List Folder ID.

new_list_folder_id.label: New List Folder ID
new_list_folder_id.description: Folder to create the new list in. Requires New List Name.

notify_url.label: Notify URL
notify_url.description: A webhook URL Brevo calls once the import finishes.

empty_contacts_attributes.label: Reset Attributes on Existing Contacts
empty_contacts_attributes.description: Blank out attributes not present in the import for contacts that already exist.

get_import_process.label: Get Import Process
get_import_process.description: Check the status of a background process such as an import.

process_id.label: Process ID
process_id.description: The process id returned by Import Contacts.

get_import_process.afterResponse:
var done = ['completed', 'failed', 'cancelled'];
return {id: response.id ?? Number(inputs.process_id), status: response.status, finished: response.status !== undefined && done.indexOf(response.status) >= 0, name: response.name, export_url: response.export_url, info: response.info};

list_contact_attributes.label: List Contact Attributes
list_contact_attributes.description: List all contact attributes configured in the Brevo account.

get_contact_campaign_stats.label: Get Contact Campaign Stats
get_contact_campaign_stats.description: Get a contact's engagement statistics (opens, clicks, deliveries, and more) across campaigns.

identifier.label: Identifier
identifier.description: Email address or numeric contact id of the contact.

start_date.label: Start Date
start_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Must be supplied together with End Date.

end_date.label: End Date
end_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Must be supplied together with Start Date. Brevo caps the range at 90 days.

get_contact_campaign_stats.beforeRequest:
if (!inputs.start_date !== !inputs.end_date) throw new Error('Provide both Start Date and End Date, or neither.');
return request;

create_contact_list.label: Create Contact List
create_contact_list.description: Create a new contact list in Brevo.

folder_id.label: Folder ID
folder_id.description: ID of the folder to create this list in. Use List Contact Lists first if you don't know a folder id; Brevo's default folder for a new account is usually id 1, but this varies.

list_contact_lists.label: List Contact Lists
list_contact_lists.description: List the contact lists in the Brevo account.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Number of lists to return per page. Maximum 50. Defaults to 10.

offset.label: Offset
offset.description: Index of the first list to return. Defaults to 0.

sort.label: Sort
sort.description: Sort order for the results, based on the list creation date.

get_contact_list.label: Get Contact List
get_contact_list.description: Get the details of a single Brevo contact list by id.

start_date.label: Start Date
start_date.description: ISO 8601 date (e.g. 2023-01-01). Must be given together with End Date for campaign statistics to appear in the response.

end_date.label: End Date
end_date.description: ISO 8601 date (e.g. 2023-01-31). Must be given together with Start Date for campaign statistics to appear in the response.

create_company.label: Create Company
create_company.description: Create a new company record in Brevo CRM.

attributes.label: Attributes
attributes.description: Custom company attributes such as domain, industry, phone_number, address, city, country. Attribute keys depend on your Brevo account's CRM configuration.

country_code.label: Phone Country Code
country_code.description: Country code for any phone number in attributes, e.g. 1 for USA, 44 for UK. Only needed when a phone attribute is set.

linked_contacts_ids.label: Linked Contact IDs
linked_contacts_ids.description: Existing Brevo contact IDs to link to this company.

linked_deals_ids.label: Linked Deal IDs
linked_deals_ids.description: Existing Brevo deal IDs to link to this company.

get_company.label: Get Company
get_company.description: Fetch a Brevo CRM company by its id.

list_companies.label: List Companies
list_companies.description: List and filter Brevo CRM companies.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Number of companies to return per page. Maximum 100.

sort_by.label: Sort By
sort_by.description: Field to sort by, e.g. createdAt or name.

filters.label: Filters
filters.description: Raw JSON filter string per Brevo's docs, e.g. {"attributes.name":"Acme"}.

linked_contacts_ids.label: Linked Contact IDs
linked_contacts_ids.description: Only return companies linked to any of these Brevo contact ids.

linked_deals_ids.label: Linked Deal IDs
linked_deals_ids.description: Only return companies linked to any of these Brevo deal ids.

delete_company.label: Delete Company
delete_company.description: Permanently delete a Brevo CRM company.

list_crm_notes.label: List CRM Notes
list_crm_notes.description: List the CRM notes in the Brevo account.

entity.label: Entity Type
entity.description: Restrict to notes attached to this entity type.

entity_ids.label: Entity IDs
entity_ids.description: Comma-separated entity IDs to filter by, e.g. a specific company or contact id.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Number of notes to return per page. Defaults to 50.

offset.label: Offset
offset.description: Index of the first note to return. Defaults to 0.

sort.label: Sort
sort.description: Sort order for the results, based on the note creation date.

list_senders.label: List Senders
list_senders.description: List the verified senders in the Brevo account.

ip.label: IP
ip.description: Filter by a specific dedicated IP; dedicated-IP accounts only.

list_sender_domains.label: List Sender Domains
list_sender_domains.description: List the sender domains configured in the Brevo account.

create_or_update_email_template.label: Create or Update Email Template
create_or_update_email_template.description: Create a new Brevo email template, or update an existing one by id.

template_id.label: Template ID
template_id.description: Provide to update an existing template; omit to create a new one.

template_name.label: Template Name
template_name.description: Required when creating a new template.

subject.label: Subject
subject.description: Required when creating a new template.

sender_email.label: Sender
sender_email.description: The verified sender the email is sent from.

html_content.label: HTML Content
html_content.description: Required when creating a new template unless HTML URL is given. Must be at least 10 characters.

html_url.label: HTML URL
html_url.description: URL Brevo fetches the HTML content from. Mutually exclusive with HTML Content.

to_field.label: To Field
to_field.description: Personalization used for the display name in the To field, for example {{contact.FIRSTNAME}}.

is_active.label: Active
is_active.description: Whether the template is active. Leave empty or pick Leave unchanged to keep the template's current active state.

create_or_update_email_template.afterResponse: return inputs.template_id ? {success: true, id: Number(inputs.template_id)} : response;

get_email_template.label: Get Email Template
get_email_template.description: Fetch a single Brevo email template by id.

template_id.label: Template ID
template_id.description: The id of the template to fetch, for example 12.

list_email_templates.label: List Email Templates
list_email_templates.description: List email templates in your Brevo account.

template_status.label: Template Status
template_status.description: Filter to active (checked) or inactive (unchecked) templates; leave unset to return both.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of templates to return. Defaults to 50, max 1000.

offset.label: Offset
offset.description: Number of templates to skip before starting to return results.

sort.label: Sort
sort.description: Sort order applied to the results, based on creation date.

delete_email_template.label: Delete Email Template
delete_email_template.description: Delete an email template from your Brevo account.

template_id.label: Template ID
template_id.description: The id of the template to delete.

create_email_campaign.label: Create Email Campaign
create_email_campaign.description: Create a new email marketing campaign in Brevo.

name.label: Name
name.description: Internal campaign name shown only in the Brevo dashboard, not to recipients.

sender_email.label: Sender
sender_email.description: The verified sender the email is sent from.

sender_name.label: Sender Name
sender_name.description: Overrides the display name of the selected sender.

sender_id.label: Sender ID
sender_id.description: Alternative to Sender Email/Sender Name: an existing Brevo sender id. Provide one or the other, not both.

subject.label: Subject
subject.description: Subject line shown to recipients. Required unless Template is selected.

template_id.label: Template ID
template_id.description: ID of an existing Brevo transactional template whose content is copied into this campaign. Mutually exclusive with HTML Content and HTML URL.

html_content.label: HTML Content
html_content.description: Required unless a template is selected. Mutually exclusive with HTML URL.

html_url.label: HTML URL
html_url.description: URL Brevo fetches the HTML content from. Mutually exclusive with HTML Content.

list_ids.label: Recipient Lists
list_ids.description: Contact lists to send this campaign to.

exclusion_list_ids.label: Exclude Lists
exclusion_list_ids.description: Contact lists to exclude from this campaign, even if a contact also belongs to a recipient list.

scheduled_at.label: Scheduled At
scheduled_at.description: Schedule the send; omit to create an unsent draft.

reply_to_email.label: Reply To
reply_to_email.description: Email address replies are sent to, if different from the sender.

preview_text.label: Preview Text
preview_text.description: Preheader text shown next to the subject line in most inboxes.

to_field.label: To Field
to_field.description: Overrides how the recipient's name/email appears in the To field, e.g. "{{contact.FIRSTNAME}}".

params.label: Template Parameters
params.description: Personalization variables available when Template is selected.

footer.label: Footer
footer.description: HTML footer appended to the campaign, typically the unsubscribe link and address.

header.label: Header
header.description: HTML header prepended to the campaign.

utm_campaign.label: UTM Campaign
utm_campaign.description: Value used for the utm_campaign tracking parameter on links in this email.

update_email_campaign.label: Update Email Campaign
update_email_campaign.description: Update an existing Brevo email campaign.

name.label: Name
name.description: Internal campaign name shown only in the Brevo dashboard, not to recipients.

sender_email.label: Sender
sender_email.description: The verified sender the email is sent from.

sender_name.label: Sender Name
sender_name.description: Overrides the display name of the selected sender.

sender_id.label: Sender ID
sender_id.description: Alternative to Sender Email/Sender Name: an existing Brevo sender id. Provide one or the other, not both.

html_url.label: HTML URL
html_url.description: URL Brevo fetches the HTML content from. Mutually exclusive with HTML Content.

list_ids.label: Recipient Lists
list_ids.description: Contact lists to send this campaign to.

exclusion_list_ids.label: Exclude Lists
exclusion_list_ids.description: Contact lists to exclude from this campaign, even if a contact also belongs to a recipient list.

scheduled_at.label: Scheduled At
scheduled_at.description: Schedule the send; omit to leave the current schedule untouched.

reply_to_email.label: Reply To
reply_to_email.description: Email address replies are sent to, if different from the sender.

preview_text.label: Preview Text
preview_text.description: Preheader text shown next to the subject line in most inboxes.

to_field.label: To Field
to_field.description: Overrides how the recipient's name/email appears in the To field, e.g. "{{contact.FIRSTNAME}}".

params.label: Template Parameters
params.description: Personalization variables available when the campaign uses a template.

footer.label: Footer
footer.description: HTML footer appended to the campaign, typically the unsubscribe link and address.

header.label: Header
header.description: HTML header prepended to the campaign.

utm_campaign.label: UTM Campaign
utm_campaign.description: Value used for the utm_campaign tracking parameter on links in this email.

get_email_campaign.label: Get Email Campaign
get_email_campaign.description: Fetch a Brevo email campaign by id, including its statistics.

statistics.label: Statistics
statistics.description: Limit the returned statistics to one category; omit for the full report.

list_email_campaigns.label: List Email Campaigns
list_email_campaigns.description: List email campaigns in the Brevo account.

start_date.label: Start Date
start_date.description: Only applies when Status is "Sent" or left empty.

end_date.label: End Date
end_date.description: Only applies when Status is "Sent" or left empty.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Number of campaigns to return per page. Maximum 100. Defaults to 50.

offset.label: Offset
offset.description: Index of the first campaign to return. Defaults to 0.

sort.label: Sort
sort.description: Sort order for the results, based on the campaign creation date.

exclude_html_content.label: Exclude HTML Content
exclude_html_content.description: Leave the HTML content out of each campaign in the response.

send_email_campaign_now.label: Send Email Campaign Now
send_email_campaign_now.description: Immediately send a draft Brevo email campaign to its recipient lists.

campaign_id.label: Campaign ID
campaign_id.description: Must currently be a draft campaign.

create_sms_campaign.label: Create SMS Campaign
create_sms_campaign.description: Create a new SMS campaign in Brevo.

sender.label: Sender
sender.description: Name or number shown as the sender. Limited to 11 alphanumeric characters or 15 numeric characters.

content.label: Content
content.description: Message body. Max 160 characters per SMS segment; longer content is split into multiple billed segments.

list_ids.label: Recipient Lists
list_ids.description: Contact lists to send this campaign to.

exclusion_list_ids.label: Exclude Lists
exclusion_list_ids.description: Contact lists to exclude from this campaign.

scheduled_at.label: Scheduled At
scheduled_at.description: Omit to create an unsent draft.

organisation_prefix.label: Organisation Prefix
organisation_prefix.description: Brand name prepended to the message content.

unsubscribe_instruction.label: Unsubscribe Instruction
unsubscribe_instruction.description: Must include the word STOP; recommended by US carriers.

get_sms_campaign.label: Get SMS Campaign
get_sms_campaign.description: Get the details of a single Brevo SMS campaign by id.

list_sms_campaigns.label: List SMS Campaigns
list_sms_campaigns.description: List the SMS campaigns in the Brevo account.

start_date.label: Start Date
start_date.description: Only filters sent campaigns; both required together.

end_date.label: End Date
end_date.description: Only filters sent campaigns; both required together.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Number of campaigns to return per page. Maximum 1000.

offset.label: Offset
offset.description: Index of the first campaign to return. Defaults to 0.

sort.label: Sort
sort.description: Sort order for the results, based on the campaign creation date.

delete_sms_campaign.label: Delete SMS Campaign
delete_sms_campaign.description: Permanently delete a Brevo SMS campaign.

list_transactional_email_events.label: List Transactional Email Events
list_transactional_email_events.description: List transactional email events (delivered, opened, clicked, bounced, etc) from Brevo.

days.label: Days
days.description: Number of past days to include, 1-90. Cannot be combined with Start Date/End Date. Brevo defaults to 30 days if none of days, start date or end date are given.

start_date.label: Start Date
start_date.description: Start of the date range, format 'YYYY-MM-DD'. Must be given together with End Date, and cannot be combined with Days. The range is capped at 90 days.

end_date.label: End Date
end_date.description: End of the date range, format 'YYYY-MM-DD'. Must be given together with Start Date, and cannot be combined with Days. The range is capped at 90 days.

email.label: Email
email.description: Filter events down to a single recipient email address.

event.label: Event
event.description: Filter down to a single event type.

tags.label: Tags
tags.description: Comma-separated tags to filter events by.

message_id.label: Message ID
message_id.description: Filter events down to a single message id.

template_id.label: Template ID
template_id.description: Filter events down to emails sent from this template id.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Number of events to return per page. Defaults to 50, maximum 5000.

offset.label: Offset
offset.description: Index of the first event to return. Defaults to 0.

sort.label: Sort
sort.description: Sort order for the results, based on the event date.

list_transactional_email_events.beforeRequest:
if (inputs.days && (inputs.start_date || inputs.end_date)) throw new Error('Provide either days, or start_date and end_date together, not both');
return request;

get_account_info.label: Get Account Info
get_account_info.description: Fetch the Brevo account holder information, plan and credits.
